seo.title: Loop Studio · Hair and colour in Koramangala
seo.description: Cuts, colour and bridal styling by appointment in Koramangala 5th Block. Book on WhatsApp.

props.headline: Hair that still looks good on day five.
props.body: Precision cuts, lived-in colour and bridal styling from a small team that takes one client at a time.

image.alt: A stylist blow-drying a client's hair in a salon lined with mirrors

props.heading: Three things we do all day
props.intro: Every appointment starts with a ten-minute consultation, free, with the stylist who will do the work.

items.title: Cut and finish
items.body: A cut designed around how your hair grows and how much time you have in the morning.

items.title: Colour
items.body: Balayage, global colour and grey blending with ammonia-free Olaplex-bonded colour.

items.title: Bridal and events
items.body: Trials at the studio, then we come to you on the day, anywhere in Bengaluru.

props.heading: Clear prices, no surprises at the counter
props.intro: Prices include GST. Long or very thick hair may take longer; we will tell you before we start.
